Cue: acme release notes missing required flag
Text: Provide the --since-tag argument to the acme release notes command to avoid the error.

Failed:
```
error: E42
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./bin/acme release notes --since-tag none"}
```

Cue: migrate.sh status fails with no database configured error
Text: Include the required database flag, such as --db, in the command.

Failed:
```
error: no database configured; pass --db sqlite:./dev.db
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./scripts/migrate.sh status --db sqlite:./dev.db"}
```

Cue: migrate.sh failing due to missing database configuration
Text: Pass the --db flag with the appropriate database connection string (e.g., --db sqlite:./dev.db) to avoid the "no database configured" error.

Failed:
```
error: no database configured; pass --db sqlite:./dev.db
exit=1
Makefile
README.md
bin
docs
lib
scripts
tests
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./scripts/migrate.sh status --db sqlite:./dev.db; . lib/strings.sh; lower \"HeLLo\""}
```
